name: fangelix
description: FAngelix (Angelix extension, MCMC-guided angelic-value search instead of KLEE): semantics-based repair of side-effect-free if/loop conditions in one C file per run — instrument, trace-based localization, angelic values that make the failing tests pass, Z3/MaxSMT synthesis of a replacement condition. Runs unchanged in its Docker image (+ VTest); files to repair from an FL ranking (--fl, default sbfl:ochiai); tests = trigger + relevant reg-tests that pass on the buggy build; HAProxy built with one thread for Angelix's trace runtime
reference: J. Yi, E. Ismayilzada. Speeding up constraint-based program repair using a search-based technique. Information and Software Technology 146:106865, 2022. Angelix: S. Mechtaev, J. Yi, A. Roychoudhury. Angelix: Scalable Multiline Program Patch Synthesis via Symbolic Analysis. ICSE 2016.
